title: Insure workers for workers' compensation
what: Insure every worker under the state's workers' compensation scheme (or be a licensed self-insurer).

laws.title: Return to Work Act 1986 (NT)
laws.provisions: Part 7, Division 3 (Employer must have adequate insurance)

sources.title: Return to Work Act 1986 (NT)
sources.locator: Part 7, Division 3: Employer must have adequate insurance, subs (1)
sources.quote: An employer, other than a self-insurer, must do the following: (a) obtain an adequate policy of insurance or indemnity; (b) ensure that the adequate policy of insurance or indemnity is in force when the employer carries on business and employs one or more workers.
